other_conditions: Applicant must be a native resident of Rajasthan.
Applicant's family should not be a taxpayer.
Applicant must be a regular student in a government or non‑government school.
Applicant must have passed Class 5 with at least 50 % marks.
Applicant must belong to one of the Special Backward Class (SBC) communities: Banjara, Baldia, Labana, Gadiya Lohar, Gadolia, Gujar, Gurjar, Raika, Rebari (Debasi), Gadaria (Gadri, Gyari).
Admission is based on merit after clearing the pre‑admission examination and class‑5 marks.
benefits_summary: Free education, accommodation, meals, uniforms, textbooks and study materials in government‑approved schools.
